lines.en: I knock on Ami’s door and immediately hear some shuffling from behind it as she hops off of her bed.
lines.zh: 我敲响 Ami 的房门,立刻听见门后一阵窸窣——她从床上跳了下来。

lines.en: : Come in! It’s open.
lines.zh: : 进来!没锁。

lines.en: I’m not sure why she needs to hop off of the bed if she’s just going to have me let myself in, but it doesn’t really matter I guess.
lines.zh: 反正我都要自己进门,她干嘛还要跳下床,搞不懂。不过这大概也不重要。

lines.en: After all, I’m-
lines.zh: 毕竟,我——

lines.en: : Attack-hug!
lines.zh: : 奔袭抱!

lines.en: Ami wraps her arms around me and squeezes with every ounce of strength that her small and unsurprisingly weak body is able to muster.
lines.zh: Ami 双臂环上来,用她那小小的、不出所料柔弱的身体所能挤出的全部力气,紧紧箍住我。

lines.en: : Why the attack-hug?
lines.zh: : 为什么是奔袭抱?

lines.en: : Because I missed you.
lines.zh: : 因为我想你了。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, hi.
lines.zh: : 那个,嗨。

lines.en: : Hi.
: I love you.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。

lines.en: : You’re being unusually clingy right now. Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : 你今天黏人得反常。出什么事了吗?

lines.en: : Does something have to be wrong for me to want to hug you?
lines.zh: : 想抱你需要理由吗?

lines.en: : No, but that’s kind of dodging the question, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 不需要,但你这算回避问题了吧?

lines.en: : Nothing’s wrong. I was just thinking about some stuff.
lines.zh: : 什么事都没有。我只是想了点事情。

lines.en: : Oh! I forgot to tell you!
lines.zh: : 哦!我忘了跟你说!

lines.en: : Uta says I can start at the maid cafe soon!
lines.zh: : Uta 说我很快就能去女仆咖啡厅上班了!

lines.en: : I met up with her earlier and she was teaching me how to talk to customers and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我之前见了她,她在教我怎么跟客人打交道什么的。

lines.en: : I told her that I deal with you all the time, so the training wasn’t like suuuuuuper necessary, but it still helped I think.
lines.zh: : 我跟她说我天天应付你,所以这种培训根本不是特别特别必要,但我觉得多少还是有用的。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine I’m particularly difficult to “deal with.”
lines.zh: : 我很难想象我有多难「应付」。

lines.en: : You’re not~ It’s almost like you’re going to be an actual adult soon.
lines.zh: : 你确实不难应付~ 感觉你马上就要长成真正的大人了。

lines.en: : They grow up so fast, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 长大得真快,对吧?

lines.en: : I did not come here to be ridiculed.
lines.zh: : 我可不是来被你嘲笑的。

lines.en: : I know. You came here to let me cuddle with you.
lines.zh: : 我知道。你是来让我抱抱的。

lines.en: : That is closer to the reason I am here, yes.
lines.zh: : 这确实更接近我来这里的原因。

lines.en: : I believe this calls for a journey to the couch then, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那么,此情此景,是不是该转移阵地去沙发?

lines.en: : As much as I like attack-hugs, this room’s prime cuddling location is a little bit closer to the wall.
lines.zh: : 虽然我也喜欢奔袭抱,但这间房的最佳拥抱位置,离墙更近一点。

lines.en: : Why not the bed then?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不干脆去床上?

lines.en: : Because if we’re on the bed, you’ll take my pants off and then I’ll take your pants off and it’ll be a whole thing.
lines.zh: : 因为上了床,你就会扒我裤子,然后我扒你裤子,然后事情就全来了。

lines.en: : I don’t see how this is a problem.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得这是什么问题。

lines.en: : Are you inviting your [niece] into bed right now? Aren’t you supposed to be a good [uncle], Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你这是在邀请你的 [niece] 上床?你不该是个好 [uncle] 吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Cuddling in bed with a girl my age is forbidden-love territory.
lines.zh: : 跟你这个年纪的女孩在床上相拥,属于禁忌之恋的领域。

lines.en: : And while I’m not really against it, I don’t think you’ve seemed particularly up for it as of late.
lines.zh: : 虽然我不算反对,但最近你的兴致看起来并不高。

lines.en: Ami brings up a good point.
lines.zh: Ami 说到点子上了。

lines.en: The last time we were in bed together, I kind of...let her down when I feel like she was expecting me to take advantage of her.
lines.zh: 上次我们同床的时候,我有点……让她失望了——当时我感觉,她其实期待我趁机对她做点什么。

lines.en: : You’re right. We should probably just sit on the couch then.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。那我们还是坐沙发吧。

lines.en: : Sorry for suggesting something that would get your hopes up.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,提了个让你空欢喜的建议。

lines.en: : It’s unfair to bring my hopes into this. Besides...
lines.zh: : 把我的期待扯进来,可不公平。况且……

lines.en: : Maya is going to be home soon anyway...and she’s always saying stuff about how you and I are a little too close.
lines.zh: : Maya 马上就要回来了……而她总是念叨,说我跟你走得太近。

lines.en: : I think she might be jealous~
lines.zh: : 我觉得她可能是吃醋了~

lines.en: : Because of me? Yeah, I definitely don’t think Maya is jealous that you get to be this close to me.
lines.zh: : 吃我的醋?得了吧,Maya 怎么可能吃「你能离我这么近」的醋。

lines.en: : Nonono, I mean she’s jealous that you get to be so close to me.
lines.zh: : 不不不,我是说她吃醋——「你居然能离我这么近」。

lines.en: : Have you even noticed how adorable I am? It’s not my fault if my roommate winds up falling in love with me.
lines.zh: : 你有注意到我有多可爱吗?要是我的室友最后爱上了我,那可不是我的错。

lines.en: : I’ll just have to tell her my heart belongs to someone else. And that person may or may not be the same person who’s helped raise me since I was a little girl.
lines.zh: : 到时候我只好告诉她,我的心已有所属。而那个人,或许正是从小把我拉扯大的那一位。

lines.en: : You still kind of are a little girl, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你现在多少也还是个小女孩,Ami。

lines.en: : Heheh~ You’re right.
lines.zh: : 呵呵~ 你说得对。

lines.en: : I’m your little girl.
lines.zh: : 我是你的小女孩。

lines.en: : Now come on. Cuddle with me on the couch for a little while.
lines.zh: : 好啦,来。陪我在沙发上抱一会儿。

lines.en: I go to move toward the couch but Ami refuses to loosen her grip on me, causing me to forcefully drag her over there as I attempt to walk both of us.
lines.zh: 我朝沙发挪动,Ami 却死死不肯松手,害得我试图同时带着两个人走路,硬生生把她拖了过去。

lines.en: Ami might be light, but she feels a lot heavier when she’s standing on my feet.
lines.zh: Ami 或许很轻,但她站在我脚背上的时候,感觉重了十倍。

lines.en: I almost knock her over a few times (One of which was intentional because I thought it might be funny), but we ultimately make it to the sofa and she quickly curls up against me.
lines.zh: 我差点绊倒她好几次(其中一次是故意的,我以为会很好笑),但最终我们成功抵达沙发,她迅速蜷进我怀里。

lines.en: : I always forget how big you are until I look at you from the side.
lines.zh: : 每次从侧面看你,我都会忘记你原来这么大只。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure I’m the same height no matter which direction you look at me from.
lines.zh: : 不管你从哪个方向看我,我的身高都是一样的。

lines.en: : Obviously. But when you face away from me like that and wrap your arm around me, I feel tiny enough to just kinda like, absorb into your skin and stuff.
lines.zh: : 显然。可当你像这样背对着我、手臂圈住我时,我就觉得自己小得可以……钻进你的皮肤里什么的。

lines.en: : Please don’t. If I absorb you, you won’t be able to cook for me anymore.
lines.zh: : 求你别。我要是把你吸收了,就没人给我做饭了。

lines.en: : I won’t be able to hug you either. But I guess the absorby thing would be kinda like a permanent hug.
lines.zh: : 我也没法抱你了。不过被吸收,大概相当于一个永恒的拥抱。

lines.en: : A permanent hug sounds good. Maybe you should absorb me after all?
lines.zh: : 永恒的拥抱听着不错。那也许你真该把我吸收了?

lines.en: : I think you’ll be fine just staying like this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你保持现在这样,就很好。

lines.en: : Hehe~ Yeah...just this is perfect.
lines.zh: : 呵呵~ 对……这样就完美了。

lines.en: We proceed to sit in silence for a suspicious amount of time.
lines.zh: 接下来,我们沉默地坐着,坐了长得可疑的一段时间。

lines.en: Ami’s normally the one to lead the two of us in conversation, but something about the way she’s acting tonight makes her feel a little different than normal.
lines.zh: 平时都是 Ami 带着我们俩聊天的,但她今晚的举止,透着一种与平常不同的感觉。

lines.en: I don’t think anything is wrong. She normally makes her moods very apparent.
lines.zh: 我不觉得出了什么事。她的情绪向来写在脸上。

lines.en: And I mean very apparent.
lines.zh: 我是说,写得明明白白。

lines.en: At this point, I can normally tell how she’s feeling by just paying attention to the inflection of her voice or the volume she’s speaking at.
lines.zh: 到了如今,光是听她说话的语气起伏、或音量高低,我就能判断她的心情。

lines.en: It’s one of the many things I like about her.
lines.zh: 这是我喜欢她的许多特质之一。

lines.en: People that are hard to read are annoying.
lines.zh: 难读懂的人很烦。

lines.en: I’m glad I didn’t wind up with a [niece] like Maya.
lines.zh: 幸好我的 [niece] 不是 Maya 那种。

lines.en: I doubt she’d even cook for me in the morning.
lines.zh: 她大概连早饭都懒得给我做。

lines.en: Ami tries a little harder to reach her arm across the length of my back, but it’s not long enough.
lines.zh: Ami 试探着把手臂伸向我背后的更远处,可惜不够长。

lines.en: She resorts to softly rubbing it instead, like she’s trying to calm down a child or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 她退而求其次,轻轻抚着我的背,像在安抚一个小孩什么的。

lines.en: It’s not a particularly enjoyable feeling, but I know she’s doing it out of affection so I let her proceed.
lines.zh: 说不上多舒服,但我知道这是她表达亲昵的方式,便由她去了。

lines.en: : Is there anything you want to talk about? You mentioned starting at the maid cafe soon, right?
lines.zh: : 有没有什么你想聊的?你刚才提到,很快就要去女仆咖啡厅上班了,对吧?

lines.en: : Are you excited to not have to bother me about money anymore?
lines.zh: : 以后不用再为钱烦我,是不是很期待?

lines.en: : A little bit. I just figured it was time to try something different.
lines.zh: : 有一点吧。我只是觉得,是时候试试不一样的活法了。

lines.en: : I’m kind of nervous, though. Like, I was ready to devote my entire life to just doing everything that you need whenever you need it.
lines.zh: : 不过我有点紧张。怎么说呢,我原本已经准备好,把你需要的每一件事、每一个瞬间都承包下来,过完这辈子。

lines.en: : But the more time we spend together, the less I feel like you actually need me.
lines.zh: : 可我们在一起的时间越久,我越觉得……你其实没那么需要我。

lines.en: : But who would-
lines.zh: : 可是谁来——

lines.en: : I’m not talking about cooking and cleaning and all of that house-wifey stuff. I’m talking about like...needing me, needing me.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是做饭打扫那些「贤妻」活儿。我说的是……需要我,真正意义上的需要。

lines.en: : I didn’t think you’d be willing to let me go so easily when the job thing came up.
lines.zh: : 工作这件事提出来的时候,我以为你不会那么轻易放我走。

lines.en: : And yeah it hurt my feelings for a little while, but if there’s anything I’ve learned over the years it’s that growing up can be kinda hard at times.
lines.zh: : 是,那确实让我难过了好一阵。但这些年我学到的一件事是:长大,有时候就是挺难的。

lines.en: : So if this is what you think I’ve gotta do to become the type of girl you want me to be...which is apparently a maid...I’ll try it out.
lines.zh: : 所以,如果这就是你认为我必须做的、才能变成你想要的那种女孩……看起来是个女仆……那我就试试。

lines.en: : This was never just about money at all, was it?
lines.zh: : 这一切,从头到尾根本就无关钱,对吧?

lines.en: : Nope! Just a last-stitch effort to get you to admit how much you need me.
lines.zh: : 完全正确!这只是让你亲口承认你有多需要我的最后手段。

lines.en: : Last ditch effort. Not stitch.
lines.zh: : 是 last ditch effort。不是 stitch。

lines.en: : Wait, what? Why? That doesn’t make any sense.
lines.zh: : 等等,什么?为什么?完全讲不通啊。

lines.en: : I thought it was stitch because like, you know, you get to the last stitch of something when you’re sewing it and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我以为是 stitch(缝),因为你知道的,缝东西缝到最后的那一针,就是 last stitch 什么的。

lines.en: : I think it’s a war reference. Like when soldiers only had one last ditch to hide in before running out into the open and getting their brains blown out.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那是战争梗。士兵们冲出去、脑袋开花之前,只剩最后一条战壕(ditch)可以躲。

lines.en: : Ew. What kind of creepy [uncle] talks about peoples’ brains getting blown out while he’s cuddling with his [niece]?
lines.zh: : 恶。什么样的变态 [uncle],会在抱着 [niece] 的时候,聊别人的脑袋开花?

lines.en: : What kind of [niece] tricks her [uncle] into supporting her efforts to get a job because she can’t realize how important she is to him?
lines.zh: : 又是什么样的 [niece],会设计骗自己的 [uncle] 支持她找工作,只因为她意识不到自己对他有多重要?

lines.en: Okay, fine.
lines.zh: 好吧,行。

lines.en: I genuinely care about Ami.
lines.zh: 我是真心在乎 Ami 的。

lines.en: For real.
lines.zh: 真的。

lines.en: There you go.
lines.zh: 给你我想要的答案了。

lines.en: It’s kind of hard not to when I spend almost half of this strange excuse for a life inside the same set of walls as her.
lines.zh: 毕竟,我这段莫名其妙的「人生」,有将近一半都和她待在同一个屋檐下,不在乎才怪。

lines.en: But that’s one of the reasons why I don’t think it’s particularly harmful for her to spend some time doing...other stuff every now and then.
lines.zh: 但这也正是我不觉得她偶尔去干点……别的事情,有什么大危害的原因。

lines.en: Just expecting her to sit around catering to me every second of every day is an unrealistic expectation.
lines.zh: 指望她一天二十四小时围着我转、伺候我,本就是不切实际的期待。

lines.en: And even if nothing about this world is real-
lines.zh: 就算这个世界没有一样东西是真的——

lines.en: Even if nothing is real in general, we can at least pretend it is.
lines.zh: 就算「真实」本身不存在,我们至少可以假装它是。

lines.en: Can’t we?
lines.zh: 不行吗?

lines.en: : That was really cute...
lines.zh: : 刚才那段,好可爱……

lines.en: : Shut up. Don’t call my words cute. I’m the picture of a cool and mysterious [uncle].
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。不许说我的话可爱。我可是高冷神秘 [uncle] 的典范。

lines.en: : You know, a lot of girls think the coolest thing a boy can do is all of that caring and affectionate stuff.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,很多女孩觉得,男生最帅的时刻,恰恰是那些体贴又深情的瞬间。

lines.en: : Say more nice things about me. Go.
lines.zh: : 再多说点我的好话。快。

lines.en: : I like how flat your chest is.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你胸的平坦。

lines.en: : Wha- That’s the opposite of nice!
lines.zh: : 啥——这是反着夸吧!

lines.en: : I’m self conscious about that part of me and you know it! Even if you’re into girls with smaller boobs!
lines.zh: : 你明知道我对自己那里没有自信!就算你喜欢小胸女孩!

lines.en: : First you kick me out of the house and tell me to get a job. Now you’re saying I have stupid boobs. You hate me, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 先把我赶出家门逼我找工作,现在又说我胸蠢。你就是讨厌我,对吧?

lines.en: : Neither of those things happened. And no. I do not hate you.
lines.zh: : 这两件事都没发生过。还有,不。我不讨厌你。

lines.en: : Then sleep over and prove it to me.
lines.zh: : 那就留下来过夜,证明给我看。

lines.en: : Didn’t you just say a little while ago that Maya was coming home? She’d kill both of us in our sleep.
lines.zh: : 你刚才不是才说 Maya 要回来了?她会趁我们睡觉把我们俩全杀了。

lines.en: : I am prepared to die as long as I can die next to you.
lines.zh: : 只要能死在你旁边,我已经准备好赴死了。

lines.en: : It would be a romantic ending to this everlasting love.
lines.zh: : 这也算是这段永恒之爱的浪漫结局了。

lines.en: : I don’t really want to die tonight.
lines.zh: : 我今晚其实不太想死。

lines.en: : If you leave here I’ll kill you.
lines.zh: : 你敢走,我就杀了你。

lines.en: : So my choices are be killed by my [niece] or be killed by my [niece]’s best friend?
lines.zh: : 所以我的选项是:被 [niece] 杀,还是被 [niece] 的挚友杀?

lines.en: : Which one will it be, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 选哪个,Sensei?

lines.en: : I choose life.
lines.zh: : 我选择活着。

lines.en: : That wasn’t one of the options.
lines.zh: : 那个选项不在选项里。

lines.en: : Besides, don’t you wanna sit around and look at cute winter outfits on my phone with me?
lines.zh: : 再说了,你不是想窝在一起,用我的手机看看可爱的冬季套装吗?

lines.en: : Since I’m finally going to be able to buy clothes, I might as well prepare myself for the change of seasons, right?
lines.zh: : 我终于能自己买衣服了,所以正好为换季做准备,对吧?

lines.en: : It’s been getting colder lately and I don’t wanna get hydrothermopoly or whatever that “Holy heck, I’m so cold” disease is.
lines.zh: : 最近天越来越冷了,我可不想得什么水热多聚玻……就是那个「天呐我好冷」病。

lines.en: : That would be hypothermia.
lines.zh: : 那叫失温症。

lines.en: : Yeah, that. I don’t want that.
lines.zh: : 对,就它。我不想得。

lines.en: : So either help me pick out clothes or resign yourself to an entire season of hugging me and carrying me around like a baby.
lines.zh: : 所以要么帮我挑衣服,要么做好心理准备——整个冬天,你都得把我当婴儿一样抱着、抱着到处走。

lines.en: : Why don’t we just go back to the mall sometime and I can help you choose there?
lines.zh: : 不如改天我们回商场,我在那边帮你挑?

lines.en: : So you’re fine with going to the mall with me as long as I’m paying?
lines.zh: : 所以只要我付钱,你就乐意陪我去商场了?

lines.en: : I need to be responsible with my money or we’ll wind up having to go the entire winter without heat.
lines.zh: : 我得对我的钱负责,不然我们俩就得过一个没有暖气的冬天。

lines.en: I’m also kind of paying for five peoples’ phone bills too, so...I kind of need to save whenever possible.
lines.zh: 毕竟我还付着五个人的话费,所以……能省则省。

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like I’m gonna say no to a day-trip with you.
lines.zh: : 好吧,跟你出去一日游这种事,我总不可能拒绝。

lines.en: : Do you think Maya could come with us, though? I kinda promised her that I wouldn’t buy any wintery stuff without at least showing her first so the two of us can match.
lines.zh: : 不过,Maya 能跟我们一起去吗?我答应过她,买冬季的东西之前至少要给她看一眼,好让她跟我配对。

lines.en: : That’s such a [teenage]girl thing to do.
lines.zh: : 真是太 [teenage] 女孩行为了。

lines.en: : Well, we are [teenage]girls, so...yeah. It kind of is.
lines.zh: : 我们本来就是 [teenage] 女孩,所以……嗯。还真就是。

lines.en: I get off the couch and Ami follows me to the door.
lines.zh: 我从沙发起身,Ami 跟着我走到门口。

lines.en: : You sure you don’t wanna stay?
lines.zh: : 你确定不多待会儿?

lines.en: : It’s less that I don’t want to and more that I should head back before Maya finds out I’ve been in the room again.
lines.zh: : 不是不想,是我最好在 Maya 发现我又进过这个房间之前回去。

lines.en: : But what if this is the last time we ever see each other?
lines.zh: : 可万一,这是我们最后一次见面呢?

lines.en: : Why on earth would this ever be the last time we see each other?
lines.zh: : 你为什么总觉得我们会「最后一次见面」?

lines.en: : I don’t know. What if the world just randomly blows up or everyone disappears all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 不知道。万一世界突然爆炸,或者所有人凭空消失呢?

lines.en: : How would you feel knowing you left your [niece] scared and alone in the middle of the apocalypse?
lines.zh: : 想象一下,天启之日,你的 [niece] 孤孤单单、惊慌失措——留下她这样的人,你作何感想?

lines.en: : You won’t be alone, you’ll have Maya.
lines.zh: : 你不会孤单,你还有 Maya。

lines.en: : I love Maya but I don’t really think she’s ‘end of the world’ material.
lines.zh: : 我爱 Maya,但我不觉得她是「世界末日」型选手。

lines.en: : You’d be surprised.
lines.zh: : 你会惊讶的。

lines.en: : But anyway, I’m going to get out of here. Want me to call you when I get home so you can confirm I wasn’t stabbed to death along the way?
lines.zh: : 总之,我走啦。到家之后要打电话向你报平安,确认我路上没被人捅死吗?

lines.en: : Yes please. I wouldn’t be able to sleep at night unless I received that exact confirmation.
lines.zh: : 要,务必。收不到那一条确认,我今晚睡不着。

lines.en: : Will do.
lines.zh: : 遵命。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Ami.
lines.zh: : 晚安,Ami。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 晚安,Sensei~

lines.en: I can feel Ami’s gaze remain on my back as I walk away from the dorm.
lines.zh: 我离开宿舍时,能感觉到 Ami 的目光一直停在我背上。

lines.en: She doesn’t follow me to the hall, but stands in the doorway watching me leave. Probably to make sure I don’t get stabbed on my way down the stairs, I guess.
lines.zh: 她没有跟到走廊,而是站在门口目送我离开。大概是想确认我下楼梯时不会被人捅了,我猜。

lines.en: I don’t know. She’s a weird girl.
lines.zh: 真搞不懂。她是个奇怪的女孩。

lines.en: But she’s my weird girl.
lines.zh: 但她是「我的」奇怪女孩。

lines.en: Or at least she is now.
lines.zh: 至少现在是。

lines.en: So that’s just something I’m going to have to deal with.
lines.zh: 所以这也是我必须学会应对的事。

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

lines.en: Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!
